Complete [[Pogahn Passage]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Rescue [[Kormir]] from [[Gandara]].
* *BONUS* Complete optional objectives.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Pogahn Passage#Walkthrough|Pogahn Passage]] mission.

== Dialogue ==

However, the landscape around the fort is marked with caverns, chasms, and natural bridges, which the local merchants use to escape the ever-vigilant eye of [[Warmarshal Varesh]]'s minions."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The quest reward is greater than that of other Zaishen quests from the region.}}

==Trivia==
*This quest was added to the Zaishen Mission cycle with the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20110303|March 3, 2011 update]]. Prior to that update, Pogahn Passage was the only [[Cooperative Mission]] without a Zaishen quest.
*This quest was first offered on March 15, 2011.
